text:
josh_fin: Flagging a weird spike in July GPU charges: $21,430 showing against `unattributed` cost center. Looks like a duplicate invoice ingestion from CloudX. Need to reconcile and propose allocation to teams (Platform/Search/Infra) or wait for vendor credit.

kelsey_ops: I pulled invoices: CloudX invoice INV-20240712 is present twice in our billing table with different ingest_ids. Suspect the ingestion retry loop created a duplicate record on 2024-07-12T03:14Z.

marco_platform: Oof. If vendor issues a credit it'll reduce our external spend; until then Finance wants internal holding allocation. What's the preferred interim split?

josh_fin: Proposal: hold on ledger as "Vendor-Dispute-Hold" and split 40/35/25 Platform/Search/Infra for internal reporting. If vendor credit arrives, we reverse entries. Need ops to run a backfill to move the duplicate invoice rows to the hold ledger tag.

rachel_search: Product ok with 35% provisional on Search, but we want a clear rollback path. Also flagging any external customers that billed features off this period. Are there any customer-facing deltas?

kelsey_ops: Quick check: these invoice lines are infra-level GPU charges, no customer pass-throughs. Customer impact = $0. Good to treat as internal.

vendor-procurement-bot: Notified vendor team: procurement@redwood.ai. Opening ticket with CloudX referencing INV-20240712 duplicate ingestion. Ticket #CX-998 created.

kelsey_ops: Suggested ops command: `psql billingdb -c "UPDATE billing_lines SET cost_center='Vendor-Dispute-Hold', note='dup INV-20240712' WHERE invoice_id='INV-20240712' AND ingest_id='dup-20240712-2'"` — will snapshot before applying.

billing-bot: Billing system: queued ledger snapshot export: gs://billing-snapshots/2024-07-INV-20240712-dup.json and re-tag job #8806. ETA 15m.

josh_fin: Finance requests ledger PR with before/after and the provisional allocation rows (40/35/25). Please include accounting codes: PLATFORM-CORE, SEARCH-TEAM, INFRA-OPS and tag `vendor_dispute`.

marco_platform: I verbally approve 40/35/25 for provisional allocation (DM). Will review ledger PR. Also will open small ingest guard in `ingest/invoice_dedupe.py` to reject same invoice_id+period duplicates.

kelsey_ops: Ran update to tag duplicate rows into hold. Snapshot saved. Job #8806 completed. Output: gs://billing-snapshots/2024-07-INV-20240712-dup.json. Adjusted rows: 42. Total held = $21,430.00.

josh_fin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/358 — contains before/after rows, allocation proposal, and audit note. Tagging @rachel_search and @procurement for approval.

vendor-procurement-bot: Procurement updated CloudX ticket #CX-998 with request for immediate reversal and receipt of corrected invoice. CloudX acknowledged; ETA 5 business days.

rachel_search: Approved provisional allocation in PR comments. Please add a rollback checklist for when vendor credit posts.

kelsey_ops: Added rollback checklist to PR and created an automation runbook: `ops/billing/rollback_on_credit.md`. It includes SQL snippet to reverse allocations and apply credit memo.

billing-bot: Ledger PR merged (#358). Accounting entries posted as provisional holds. Procurement will update when CloudX issues credit.

josh_fin: Closing this thread for now. Will reopen if CloudX credit arrives or if any teams see anomalies. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
